thesis: Wide day-ahead spreads and nothing contracted, with a home fleet that doubles this year. Bulgaria's batteries mostly stay behind the border; Romania's own build takes about 17% off the two-hour value by 2027. Two hours is the best design on merchant revenue alone; a fund enters only with a negotiated optimiser floor, whose terms are not yet priced here.
日前价差宽但没有任何合同化收入，且本国储能规模今年翻倍。保加利亚的电池大多被边境阻隔；罗马尼亚自身的建设到2027年将使两小时价值减少约17%。仅按市场化收入测算，两小时是最佳设计；基金只有在谈定优化商保底后才进入，而该保底条款尚未在此定价。
